newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's CIL in notes issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's CIL in notes issue.

text.p: Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL on Monday said it has launched a three million dinars five-year notes issue.
Interest of 10 percent would be paid annually, the privately owned firm said.
CIL said the issue was garanteed by Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie, which holds a 10 percent stake in the CIL's capital of 7.5 million dinars.
Italy's FIME Leasing Spa and Netherlands' FMO hold each respectively 15 and five percent in CIL's capital.
Deadline for subscription was set for October 31, CIL said.
Price issue for each note is 100 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
